own_solution.law: At galvanometer null, R_left/X = l/(Lw-l), so rho = R_left (Lw-l) pi d^2/(4 l Lx). With R_left = 12 Ω, l = 41.5 cm, Lw = 100 cm, d = 0.0003 m and Lx = 1.5 m, X = 16.91566 Ω and rho = 7.97132e-7 Ω m. Adding q in series in the left gap replaces R_left by 12 Ω + q.
assumptions: The uniform bridge wire has resistance proportional to length.
The sample has a uniform circular cross section.
The lamp and its battery form a separate circuit.
The reported null position applies after the modification made before balancing.
The stated negligible connection resistances and steady wire temperatures apply.

notes: All certified answers agree with the bridge equations. For either relevant sentence, added resistances of 4.6, 9.4 and 17 Ω give respectively 1.10270e-6, 1.42155e-6 and 1.92640e-6 Ω m. The bridge-wire diameter cancels through the common cross-sectional area at all three listed diameters. SI conversion of the sample diameter is required when evaluating its area.
